name: Auto Deco
description: One-click level decorator for the editor. Learns your deco palette and fills your level with it.

style.name: Style
style.description: <cg>Clean</c>: sparse and tidy. <cy>Detailed</c>: balanced. <cr>Chaotic</c>: dense, random rotations, mixed sizes.

density.name: Density
density.description: How much decoration to place. 50 is normal.

max-objects.name: Max Objects
max-objects.description: Safety cap on how many objects one run may add (high values can lag the editor).

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: 0 = new random result every time. Any other number repeats the same layout.

align-to-surfaces.name: Align To Surfaces
align-to-surfaces.description: Rotate deco to face away from the block it sits on. Turn off for fully random rotation.

background-scatter.name: Background Scatter
background-scatter.description: Also scatter larger deco in the empty space behind the level.

palette-ids.name: Palette IDs
palette-ids.description: Optional. Comma-separated object IDs to decorate with, e.g. <cy>1705, 1706</c>. Only used when nothing is selected in the editor. Non-decoration IDs are ignored for safety.
